secondary_completion_rate.pilot_comparison: iteration-9's pilot ran 6 cells with 9 dispatches (4 completed first pass, 67%) and retried everything to completion. This run used exactly 1 attempt per cell and got 41.7%. The two numbers measure different things; this one is the honest one.
secondary_completion_rate.failure_mode: silence. No partial file, no error message, just no output. Truncation cannot detect it because there is nothing to truncate.
secondary_completion_rate.no_file_size_pattern: flow_logic (1115 lines) completed 3 of 4 times. objects_program (1598) completed 1 of 4. object_fugr (1530) completed 1 of 4. Larger files fail more, but flow_logic fails too.

reading_under_plan_section_4.applicable_read: 两臂排除数不同 -> 不可判定
reading_under_plan_section_4.detail: run-1 exclusions split 1 (b8f84e8) vs 2 (718f5988); run-2 split 2 vs 2. Either way the exclusion counts differ by arm, so the plan says the comparison is reported as undetermined and only the direction is stated.
reading_under_plan_section_4.direction: On the completed-but-unpaired reports the newer version carried 0 defect instances across 2 reports and the older carried 7 across 3. Direction favours the newer version. It is not evidence.
reading_under_plan_section_4.what_not_to_write: Do not write 'the fix works' or 'the fix does not work'. Neither is supported by 1 tied pair.

what_this_run_actually_established: On 1100-1600-line real ABAP sources, a single undirected dispatch produces a usable report about 42% of the time. That is the headline, and it is about the delivery mechanism, not about either skill version.
When a report does get produced, it is structurally complete (6/6 sections) and its ABAP quotations are all verbatim-faithful. Neither version, of the 5 reports that exist.
A skill version difference cannot be measured through a completion funnel this leaky. The primary endpoint needs retries to exist at all, and retries are what would invalidate it.
The gate, the pairing, and the sign test all worked correctly on a design that could not reach their bar. The harness is not the problem.
what_it_did_not_do: Compare the two skill versions. 1 tied pair is not a comparison.
Establish a base rate for b8f84e8 on real code. Only 3 of its 6 reports exist.
Measure the truncation coverage signal. All sources are under its 2000-line threshold.
Measure recall. Real sources have no defect reference list.
provenance_hazards_hit_this_session: b8f84e8 had never been installed as a loadable skill; the pilot's whole 'old' arm silently ran 718f5988. Fixed by installing the pinned copy and adding a pre-dispatch digest check to the plan.

The three source sha256 values I typed into the first wave of prompts were invented - all three diverged from the real digest at position 13. Agents read the file by path, so no report is affected, but one agent caught the mismatch and reported it.
I added a scope-limiting sentence to one pilot prompt, contaminating that cell. Logged in iteration-9/pilot-metadata.json.
Two tool-level aborts during run-2 were not measured attempts and were re-dispatched; one of those cells was also never dispatched at all because of a malformed tool call on my side.
